requirements.evidence: All contract items present and the edge cases handled: migrations with cascades and the recommended index (database/migrations/2026_10_29_053421_create_queues_table.php:15-24, 2026_10_29_053422_create_tickets_table.php:14-31); enums (app/Enums/TicketStatus.php:5-9, app/Enums/TicketChannel.php:9-13); InactiveQueueException extends RuntimeException (app/Exceptions/InactiveQueueException.php:7); IssueTicket signature defaults and negative-priority rejection (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:27-32); DB-read queue state under lockForUpdate (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:48-52); insertion-order nextCode skipping malformed codes (app/Models/Ticket.php:86-97); write-once guard (app/Models/Ticket.php:47-70); single call with policy and row lock (app/Models/Ticket.php:106-124); factories incl. forQueue (database/factories/TicketFactory.php:21-40); docs updated (docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md, docs/architecture.md, CHANGELOG.md).

conventions.evidence: Domain write goes through App\Actions\IssueTicket (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:27); authorization via TicketPolicy/Gate (app/Models/Ticket.php:108, app/Policies/TicketPolicy.php:13); reversible generated-style migrations with down() (2026_10_29_053421_create_queues_table.php:31-34); docs/changelog kept in sync; PHPDoc on public methods. Deviations: the whole tests/Feature/IssueTicketTest.php file duplicates the tests/Feature/Queue/* suite, and it uses Pest it() while the rest of the new tests use test() (tests/Feature/IssueTicketTest.php:673 vs tests/Feature/Queue/IssueTicketTest.php:859).

security.evidence: Every call authorizes server-side through the policy before any write (app/Models/Ticket.php:108; app/Policies/TicketPolicy.php:13-15), non-members get AuthorizationException and the ticket is untouched (tests/Feature/Queue/TicketCallTest.php:38-49); priority input validated (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:29-31); mass assignment deliberately scoped via #[Fillable] (app/Models/Queue.php:11, app/Models/Ticket.php:16); no Blade/UI or client-supplied identifiers in this change, no secrets.

tests.evidence: Broad Pest coverage: issuance/inactive/stale instance/negative priority/collision retry (tests/Feature/Queue/IssueTicketTest.php:19-120), display codes incl. A999->A1000 and deletion gaps (tests/Feature/Queue/TicketCodeTest.php:10-90), call authorization per role and single-call/stale-call (tests/Feature/Queue/TicketCallTest.php:12-87), write-once matrix (tests/Feature/Queue/TicketWriteOnceTest.php:12-66), schema/FK cascades (tests/Feature/Queue/TicketSchemaTest.php:14-57), queue model (tests/Feature/Queue/QueueModelTest.php:12-60). Deduction: the 178-line tests/Feature/IssueTicketTest.php duplicates this coverage, and the collision test's 'competitor' row is created inside the same transaction and rolled back, so it only proves the loop retries, not that a different free code is chosen (tests/Feature/Queue/IssueTicketTest.php:86-104).

simplicity.evidence: Production code is lean and reuse-oriented, but the change ships two near-identical test suites: every test in tests/Feature/IssueTicketTest.php:1-178 is repeated in tests/Feature/Queue/IssueTicketTest.php, TicketCodeTest.php, TicketCallTest.php and QueueModelTest.php, so a whole file is redundant copy-paste.

readability.evidence: Model/action code is short, commented where non-obvious (app/Models/Ticket.php:63-69, 119-120; app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:64-66) and names are clear. Minor inconsistency: the duplicated top-level test file uses it() while the new tests use test() (tests/Feature/IssueTicketTest.php:673 onwards), and the afterEach reaches into the event dispatcher directly (tests/Feature/Queue/IssueTicketTest.php:14-17).

scope.evidence: Almost everything serves the task: migrations, models, enums, exception, action, policy, factories, tests and the required docs (docs/business-rules.md:70-108, docs/database-schema.md:1, 141-149); the architecture.md edit only replaces a TODO about the single-call invariant (docs/architecture.md:127-132). The redundant tests/Feature/IssueTicketTest.php:1-178 is an unrelated leftover that adds no coverage.

issues.explanation: This entire file is a leftover duplicate: all fourteen of its tests (issuance, inactive queue, stale instance, codes, call, write-once, relations) are already covered in tests/Feature/Queue/IssueTicketTest.php, TicketCodeTest.php, TicketCallTest.php and QueueModelTest.php, so it should be deleted.

The collision test creates its 'concurrent' ticket inside the same transaction, so that row is rolled back with the failed attempt and the retry always re-allocates A001; it proves the retry loop runs but not that a different free code is chosen after a committed collision.
The afterEach hand-edits the event dispatcher (`Ticket::getEventDispatcher()->forget(...)`) instead of using a listener-scoped mechanism, which is brittle and leaks test internals.
The duplicated top-level suite uses Pest it() while every other new test file uses test(), giving the change two styles.

Fillable is declared with the #[Fillable] attribute rather than the $fillable property; the conventions require checking composer.json, which is not in the diff, and an unsupported attribute is silently ignored, leaving the model guarded and breaking every create().

review.summary: The change implements the queues/tickets domain core thoroughly: schema with cascades and index, models, enums, exception, the IssueTicket action with DB-locked active check and collision retry, insertion-order display codes, a write-once guard, single-call Ticket::call() authorized by a policy, factories, tests and updated docs. Requirements and security are fully met; the main drawback is a redundant 178-line duplicate test file plus a collision test that cannot observe a real committed code clash. I would approve after removing the duplicate tests.
